items.title: Yemeni military claims 744 strikes, ~200 Houthis 'neutralized' in 24 hours under Operation Dawn of Yemen
items.summary: Colonel Majed al-Nuzaily, spokesman for Yemen's armed forces, said Tuesday that government forces carried out 744 strikes in the previous 24 hours — 'neutralizing' around 200 Houthi fighters and destroying or damaging 90 military vehicles and pieces of equipment. In an X post, he said the strikes used warplanes, drones, field artillery, rocket launchers and snipers against Houthi command-and-control centers, fortified positions, firing sites, troop concentrations, reinforcements and supply routes; in Taiz, he said government troops were pushing Houthis into retreat across eastern, southern and western fronts. On Monday he had claimed 1,164 strikes and 558 fighters neutralized in the preceding 24h. Both are government claims, not independently verified.
